blocks.html: Finish the Device Setup Wizard by enabling the Data Sync plugin and elevation data, then review your preferences and set the measurement units.

slides.title: Install the Data Sync plugin
slides.html: The application asks whether to install plugins. Select DataSync and press OK.

slides.title: Download elevation data (DTED-0)
slides.html: WinTAK then asks whether to download DTED-0 elevation models automatically. Select Yes.

slides.title: Review My Preferences
slides.html:
The basic setup is done — check My Preferences. Your Callsign, team colour (My Team) and role (My Role) should match what you were assigned, and My Display Type should be Ground.

If you are a command post user, your role should be HQ.

slides.title: Check the TAK Network Status
slides.html: Check the TAK Network Status: a green cloud means the server connection is OK, red means disconnected. If it stays red, check your internet connection and restart WinTAK (see Troubleshooting).

slides.title: Open unit settings
slides.html: Now set the measurement units. Press the hamburger menu (three stacked lines) in the top-left corner, then select Settings.

slides.title: Open Display Preferences
slides.html: Select Display Preferences, then open Unit Display Format Preferences.

slides.title: Set the unit format
slides.html: Check that the unit settings match the picture, and change them if necessary.

slides.title: WinTAK is set up
slides.html: WinTAK is now set up. The usage guide following the standard model is under Usage by Role — and on this Deploy App's front-page menu under Usage.
